title: Drowning
content: (For context this is a real dream I've had and is not made up) Me and my sister had wondered dark grimy cement halls. It almost looked as if we were trapped in a castle. The hallways only lit by torches on the wall. Before we could explore or find a way out. 2 gaurds stopped us and took us prisoner in a room. There were 2 tubs on the floor and a desk lining the back wall and right wall in a L shape. On top of the poorly made L shaped desk was a giant cage the shape of the desk. They separated me and my sister and locked us in the cage as they filling up the tubs. I was screaming, crying and hyperventilating. Begging the 2 men to let us go. They didnt respond and ignored our pleading. They grabbed us angrily and aggressively out of the cages and poked us each with a needle that had an unknown liquid in it. Than than drowned us in the tubs at the same time. I flailed but soon slipped out of consciousness. I woke up in my bed balling my eyes out. I watched me and my sister die. I was a child. That dream has stuck with me since. Now that I'm an adult I think back, what if it was a secret base? What if me and my sister were test subjects?
